question: In the froth flotation study the review cites, what collector was used, what share of the graphite floated, and what purity and total recovery did the cathode tailing product reach?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%flotation%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%collector%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%tailing%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%purity%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=7 AND line_no BETWEEN 25 AND 60 OR (page=7 AND id IN ('p7.L84','p7.L95','p7.L97','p7.L99')) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (7,8) AND line_no BETWEEN 85 AND 110 OR page=8 AND line_no<=12 ORDER BY page, line_no
